summary: Development candidate with authenticated release notes in local desktop settings. This candidate has not been released.

items: View signed release summaries, details and cached release history in device settings.
Release notes are authenticated separately and tied to the exact signed installer manifest. Unverified release descriptions are not shown as trusted notes.
Assist remains disabled and has not passed physical-device acceptance.
The desktop-owned installer handoff is still under development. Routine installation currently uses the existing Update Manager.

compatibility: Windows x64. Existing account sessions and local application data are retained.
